title: Coast Guard flies rescued manatee to Orlando
description: The Coast Guard partnered with the Fish and Wildlife Service to transport a manatee that was rescued in Trinity Bay, near Houston, and rehabilitated at SeaWorld San Antonio, to SeaWorld Orlando Feb. 18, 2015. Trinidad the manatee was released into the wild off Florida March 4, 2015.
